freshness_basis.r35-runtime-current: R36 operational closure receipt (CLOSED / ACCEPTED_LIVE) supersedes R35 as current HANRI runtime.
freshness_basis.r35-latest-run: R36 operational closure receipt supersedes R35 latest-run state for current-runtime claims.
freshness_basis.r35-human-digest-current: R36 operational closure receipt supersedes R35 human digest for current-runtime claims.
freshness_basis.r35-accepted-git: Accepted R36 Git baseline supersedes R35 for current-runtime identity.
freshness_basis.r37-phase1-accepted-git: R37 phase-3 accepted Git state supersedes phase-1 for current product-state claims.
freshness_basis.r37-phase2-accepted-git: R37 phase-3 accepted Git state supersedes phase-2 for current product-state claims.
freshness_basis.fable-handoff-r64: Operational status claims from a handoff require a confirmation not older than 24 hours.
freshness_basis.r64-package: A package acceptance artifact does not prove current executor readiness after 24 hours.
freshness_basis.decision-governor-01: Operational decision-queue status requires confirmation not older than 24 hours.
freshness_basis.operator-d5-current: Human operator workflow status is treated as current for at most 24 hours without a newer report.

history_policy: events are append-only historical facts and are not evidence-ref rewritten
